versions.changelog:
Initial release of changelog-writer skill.

- Generates user-friendly changelog entries from raw commit logs, PRs, or change lists.
- Organizes release notes by type: Added, Changed, Deprecated, Fixed, Security.
- Surfaces breaking changes and upgrade steps at the top, following Keep a Changelog and semantic versioning conventions.
- Outputs are concise, grouped, exclude internal-only details, and are tailored to end-users or developers.
- Ensures changelog entries are in plain language, omitting raw commit messages and technical noise.
